matrix_name.name: polyetherimide
matrix_name.description: Expanded polyetherimide (EPEI) foam bead matrix; the PEI granules were acetone-soaked and foamed with CO2/THF, and the bead surface was later treated before CNS coating.
matrix_name.surface_treatment: THF treated for 5 min before CNS coating

matrix_name.name: epoxy resin
matrix_name.description: Epoxy bonding phase used to assemble and bond the EPEI/CNS foam beads during compression molding; a 50 wt% diluted epoxy/ethanol formulation was selected for preparing the EMI shielding foams.

fillers.name: carbon nanostructures
fillers.description: Segregated CNS coating on EPEI bead surfaces; described as cross-linked and branched carbon nanotube networks.
